map.按弹性理论经验系数法估算双向板短跨与长跨方向弯矩。: Moments in the short and long span directions of a two-way slab using the empirical coefficients of elastic theory.
map.均布荷载 q、四边简支矩形板（泊松比 ν=0.2）跨中弯矩：取短跨 l_s =: Mid-span moments of a rectangular slab simply supported on four edges under a uniform load q (Poisson ratio ν = 0.2): take the short span l_s = min(l_x, l_y), the long span l_l = max(l_x, l_y), and the ratio r = l_l ÷ l_s; when r > 2.0, cap it at 2.0. Coefficient table (r, α_x, α_y): (1.0, 0.0479, 0.0479), (1.2, 0.0614, 0.0384), (1.4, 0.0706, 0.0328), (1.6, 0.0770, 0.0286), (1.8, 0.0812, 0.0256), (2.0, 0.0836, 0.0234); interpolate linearly in r between adjacent rows: α = α_i + (α_{i+1} − α_i)·(r − r_i)/(r_{i+1} − r_i). Both moments are referred to the short span squared: M_x = α_x·q·l_s², M_y = α_y·q·l_s² (kN·m/m), with ratio M_x/M_y = α_x/α_y. Validation: if q, l_x or l_y is ≤ 0, the page reports "Please enter valid parameters.". Scope: this table applies only to mid-span moments of slabs simply supported on four edges with ν = 0.2; fixed edges and continuous panels (interior/edge/corner) use different coefficients and are not covered here.

map.两向弯矩均按短跨 l_x² 折算：M_x = α_x·q·l_x²，M_y =: Both directions are reduced to the short span l_x²: M_x = α_x·q·l_x², M_y = α_y·q·l_x²
map.系数按 l_y/l_x 查表线性插值；l_y/l_x ≥ 2 时按单向板设计（系: Coefficients are looked up from the table and linearly interpolated by l_y/l_x; when l_y/l_x ≥ 2 the slab is designed as one-way (coefficients capped at the 2.0 row)
map.📚 深度解析：双向板弯矩估算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: two-way slab moment estimate (civil)
map.矩形双向板：按长边/短边比 r 查四边简支跨中系数，求两向跨中弯矩并据此分配底筋: Rectangular two-way slabs: use the long-to-short side ratio r to look up the four-edge simply supported mid-span coefficients, obtain the mid-span moments in both directions, and distribute the bottom steel accordingly.
map.跨度接近方形（r≈1）：α_x=α_y，两向弯矩相同，按两向等量配筋。: Nearly square span (r ≈ 1): α_x = α_y, so both moments are equal and the steel is provided equally in both directions.
map.长宽比 ≥2：系数按 2.0 行封顶，长跨弯矩迅速减小，受力接近单向板。: Aspect ratio ≥ 2: coefficients are capped at the 2.0 row, the long-span moment drops quickly, and the behavior approaches a one-way slab.
map.方形四边简支双向板系数: Coefficients for a square slab simply supported on four edges
map.3m×3m 四边简支双向板、q=10kN/m²：r=1.0，查表 α_x=α_y: For a 3 m × 3 m slab simply supported on four edges with q = 10 kN/m²: r = 1.0, and the table gives α_x = α_y = 0.0479, so M_x = M_y = 0.0479 × 10 × 3² = 4.31 kN·m/m; provide mid-span bottom steel for 4.31 kN·m/m in both directions. (Slabs fixed on all four edges use different coefficients, so this table does not apply.)
map.双向板系数怎么查？: How do I look up the two-way slab coefficients?
map.本页只给四边简支、ν=0.2 的跨中系数：取长宽比 r 在 1.0–2.0 之间: This page tabulates only mid-span coefficients for four-edge simply supported slabs with ν = 0.2: interpolate linearly in the aspect ratio r between 1.0 and 2.0, and cap r > 2.0 at the 2.0 row. Fixed edges and continuous panels (interior/edge/corner) use different coefficients and require the corresponding tables.
map.为什么不按单向配筋？: Why not reinforce it as a one-way slab?
map.短边/长边<2 时两向均受力，只配短向会漏掉长向弯矩，角部上翘需负筋，误配易开裂: When the short-to-long side ratio is below 2 both directions act. Reinforcing only the short direction misses the long-span moment, and the upturned corners need negative steel, so mis-reinforcement leads to cracking.
map.板厚怎么定？: How is the slab thickness set?
map.双向板厚常取短跨 1/40~1/50 并满足冲切与最小厚，太大不经济、太小挠度裂: Two-way slabs often take 1/40 to 1/50 of the short span while satisfying punching and the minimum thickness. Too thick is uneconomic, too thin gives excessive deflection and crack width, so size it from the span first and then check.
map.本页定位：仅做弹性薄板弯矩系数查算: Scope of this page: elastic thin-plate bending-moment coefficient lookup only
map.不含挠度验算与裂缝宽度验算: it does not perform deflection or crack-width checks
